newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin health statement likely in two hours.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin health statement likely in two hours.

text.p: The Kremlin is likely to release a statement about the health of Russian president Boris Yeltsin "in the next two hours", a spokesman said on Tuesday. He was speaking soon after 6 p.m. (1500 GMT).

Officials had earlier said news about Yeltsin's health was likely after a meeting of doctors. Yeltsin, 65, is being treated for pneumonia in hospital. Russian agencies quoted unnamed sources as saying he met chief-of-staff Anatoly Chubais on Tuesday.
